priorities.summary: WPMasterToolKit for WordPress contains a code injection vulnerability (CWE-94) affecting versions through 2.26.1, rated Critical by Patchstack. A logged-in user with low privileges can inject and execute code on affected sites.
priorities.plain: Attackers with a low-level account on a WordPress site using WPMasterToolKit could run their own code on it - update the plugin now.

priorities.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir), rated Critical with a maximum CVSSv3 score of 9.8 by Broadcom in advisory VMSA-2026-0011. Fixes are available in vCenter 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300 and 8.0 U3m.
priorities.plain: Attackers who can reach a vCenter server could get in without a valid login - patch vCenter to the fixed release now.
priorities.product: VMware vCenter Server / VMware Cloud Foundation / VMware Telco Cloud Platform / VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure

priorities.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which places the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Once a crafted pull request is merged, the injected commands run with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.
priorities.plain: Attackers could slip commands into a ToolJet release through a crafted pull request title and push code into linked repositories - upgrade ToolJet now.

model.name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview
model.summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview as open weights under Apache 2.0, a sparse mixture-of-experts model built for fast long-document and agentic work. It gives teams a frontier-class model they can download, modify and self-host instead of renting only through an API.
model.plain: An open model clients can download and run themselves for document work and AI agents, cutting reliance on paid hosted services.
